title: Concept: Dynamic evaluation via toolBox.eval (scala) — review required
description: In scala, toolBox.eval runs a string as code, so any value that reaches the string executes with the process's privileges. The remedy is a fixed code path (compiled code) instead of runtime evaluation.
applicability: scala codebases evaluating strings; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution on untrusted input; HIGH severity.
